entry.title: New: RES26-248 (Honolulu) — INTRO
entry.content:
ACCEPTING A GIFT OF TRAVEL AND RELATED EXPENSES, VALUED AT $1,307.38, TO THE CITY FROM THE FEDERAL HIGHWAY ADMINISTRATION (FHWA) HAWAIʻI DIVISION FOR A REPRESENTATIVE OF THE DEPARTMENT OF TRANSPORATION SERVICES TO ATTEND THE FHWA EVERY DAY COUNTS ROUND 8 PEER EXCHANGE IN SALT LAKE CITY, UTAH, FROM OCTOBER 20-22, 2026.

Latest action: Introduced.
